title: GKE XPK Training Payload Variables
description: Configuration variables for multi-slice GKE XPK distributed TPU training workloads.

XPK_CLUSTER_NAME.description: Name of the target GKE XPK cluster.

WORKLOAD_NAME.description: Unique identifier for the XPK training workload.

TRAIN_SCRIPT.description: Training entrypoint command executed inside the container across TPU slices.

DOCKER_IMAGE.description: Container image containing the JAX/MaxText/PyTorch training environment.

TPU_ACCELERATOR_TYPE.description: TPU accelerator topology (e.g. v4-8, v5litepod-16, v5p-8).

TPU_SLICE_COUNT.description: Number of TPU slices for multi-slice data-parallel / FSDP training.

TPU_SCHEDULING_TYPE.description: Provisioning scheduling mode ('spot' for TFRC/preemptible or 'on-demand').

GCP_PROJECT_ID.description: Google Cloud Project ID hosting the GKE XPK cluster.

GCP_ZONE.description: Google Cloud compute zone where the TPU nodes reside.

HF_TOKEN.description: Optional Hugging Face authentication token injected into the workload.
